content:
- Model consistently overestimates prices, especially in the early part of the forecast horizon (first 5–10 days).
- Overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., 75+), then underestimates the subsequent decline.
- Underestimates low-price periods (e.g., 68–70 range) and fails to capture mean reversion toward historical averages.
- Forecast lags behind true price movements, particularly in the middle to late horizon (days 15–30).
- Overconfident in short-term upward momentum; fails to account for volatility clustering or policy-induced corrections.
- Tends to ignore recent low-price trends when forecasting, leading to persistent bias toward higher values.
